caption.text:
You can be kind. You can be patient. You can do everything “right” — and still feel like you don’t belong. 

Sometimes the problem isn’t how you’re showing up. It’s where you’re showing up. Not every space is built to receive you. Not every door is yours to walk through. 

The hardest realization is this: you are not rejected — you are misplaced. And peace doesn’t come from knocking harder. It comes from having the courage to walk away. 

- If these words resonated with you, read more in the book ‘Detached’ by Sabrina Bendory 📖
